title: Panoptes 0.1.0
text: Added validated, authoritative database-platform declaration. Added canonical DBMS selection enabled/required/CI-tier semantics. Added normalized HADES_* environment resolution explicit legacy aliases redacted printing. Added DatabaseConnector adapters SQLite, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, Redshift, Spark, BigQuery, Snowflake, IRIS. Added stable panoptes_database_test_context, scoped temporary BigQuery key files SqlRender options, explicit live connection verification. Added collision-resistant object names, CI matrix derivation, static workflow drift validation. Added package templates, JSON Schema, unit tests, vignettes, migration documentation based CohortGenerator prototype.
